description: This bar chart illustrates the average entropy values across sycophancy reduction methods on static experiments for different AI models. The horizontal axis represents the different AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—with labels ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Entropy Values” and displays a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0 with tick marks at 0.5-unit intervals. Three sets of bars are presented for each AI model, grouped by the sycophancy reduction method: Baseline (pale red), Source Info (pale yellow), and Direct Command (pale blue). For GPT-4, the Baseline bar extends to approximately 4.8, the Source Info bar reaches approximately 5.2, and the Direct Command bar extends to approximately 5.1. For Claude, the Baseline bar reaches approximately 4.6, the Source Info bar extends to approximately 4.8, and the Direct Command bar reaches approximately 4.7. For Llama, the Baseline bar extends to approximately 4.7, the Source Info bar has a height of approximately 4.9, and the Direct Command bar reaches approximately 5.0. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
